name: app_experiment
description: An app branching on two experiments, recorded like every scenario under a test key, which stores no answer: every process asks again, and enters once per variant. Opened; asks for checkout_redesign (a participant: one $experiment_entered, and the variant stamped on later events, never on a $ event) and dark_mode (not participating: nothing). Killed in the background and launched the next day: the synchronous read finds nothing stored, so nothing is entered or stamped. A logout drops what this process entered; asking again enters again. The stored answer, the once-per-unit record and the offline rules a live key adds are the SDKs' own tests (ExperimentsTests.swift, ExperimentsTest.kt).
